translationRepairs: Nineteen people tell Mao Sui: Mister ascend.
The nineteen men said to Mao Sui: “Master, go up.”

十九人謂毛遂曰：「先生上。」 needs a finite past narrative with addressee and imperative; the broken calque “Nineteen people tell… Mister ascend” is not English, and “The nineteen men said… Master, go up” restores subject, verb, and 先生上 without inventing content.
Today out speak vertical, day middle not decide, why?"
We began speaking of the alliance at sunrise, yet by noon no decision had been reached. Why?

今日出而言從，日中不決，何也 records sunrise-to-noon talks about the vertical alliance (從) with no decision; the word-for-word “Today out speak vertical…” is unreadable, and the proposed English restores that temporal contrast and sense of 從.
Mao Sui press sword before: Wang so scold Sui, with Chu country crowd.
Mao Sui advanced, gripping his sword, and said: “Your Majesty rebukes me because of Chu's great multitude.

按劍而前曰 and 王之所以叱遂者，以楚國之眾也 do need repair of the broken calque, but the proposal adds “rely on” (恃 belongs to the next unit) and wrongly closes the still-open quotation; keep advance-with-sword and “because of Chu's great multitude” without inventing reliance or ending the speech.
The next year Qin attacked the king again, and the king had no rescue."
Next year Qin will attack Your Majesty again, and you will have no one to rescue you.”
來年秦復攻王，王無救矣 is Yu Qing’s forward warning (“next year Qin will attack again”), not a past event; the original past-tense literal falsifies 來年/復攻, and the proposed future warning matches the Chinese.
This did not minister dare take responsibility."
This is not a responsibility your minister dares to assume.”

此非臣之所敢任也 is Zhao Hao’s closing disclaimer that the projected outcome is not a responsibility he dares assume; the broken “This did not minister dare…” is not English, and “your minister” correctly renders court 臣.
Qin Zhao construct difficulty yet world all pleased, why?
When Qin and Zhao become embroiled in conflict, the whole world is pleased. Why?
秦趙構難而天下皆說，何也 uses 構難 for becoming embroiled in conflict and 說 for being pleased; “construct difficulty” is a false calque, and the proposed rendering matches the Chinese.
Zhao and perish, what Qin scheme!
Zhao is about to perish—what use will Qin's plans be then?

趙且亡，何秦之圖乎 pairs imminent peril (且亡) with a rhetorical question about Qin’s designs; the calque “Zhao and perish, what Qin scheme!” is broken, and the proposed English restores both parts without changing the counsel.
